patthana16.93:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ niyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na anidassanaappaṭigho na niyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.93:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika sauttaraduke nasanidassanattika nasauttaradukaṃ
